title: The Telangana Occupants of Homesteads (Conferment of Ownership) Act, 1976.
full_text: The Telangana Occupants of Homesteads (Conferment of Ownership) Act, 1976. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 197621 Act Number: 21 Enactment Date: 1976-03-09 Act Year: 1976 Short Title: The Telangana Occupants of Homesteads (Conferment of Ownership) Act, 1976. Long Title: An Act provide for the conferment of right of ownership on landless agriculturists, agricultural labourers and artisans in respect of sites occupied by and adjacent to, their dwelling houses or huts in rural areas of the State of Telangana. Department: Department of Revenue Enforcement Date: 14-08-1975 Type: STATE Location: Telangana TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section Section 1. Short title, extent, commencement and application. Section 2. Declaration as to giving effect to certain directive principles. Section 3. Definitions. Section 4. Bar to eviction of an occupant of homestead for dwelling house or homestead. Section 5. Occupant of homestead to become owner. Section 6. Issue of certificate of ownership of homestead. Section 7. Disputes to be decided by the authorised officer. Section 8. Appeal. Section 9. Revision. Section 10. Powers of authorised officer to call for information, summoning of witnesses etc. Section 11. Bar of jurisdiction of Civil Courts. Section 12. Authorised officer etc., to be public servants. Section 13. Protection of action taken in good faith. Section 14. Act to over-ride other laws. Section 15. Power to make rules. Section 16. Exemptions. Section 17. Repeal of Ordinance.
